result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly clean and well structured. The carousel clipping and the partially visible card at the bottom are expected behavior and not reported. I found only a few minor cosmetic and accessibility concerns, and nothing that clearly breaks the layout or blocks functionality.

issues.description: Secondary gray text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', the '(500+)' rating count) is light gray on white and has borderline contrast. The search placeholder text is also low contrast against its light gray field.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and placeholder colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the plate image on the first card and sit close to the food art. The white pill on the light Green Bowl Poké card has little separation from the background.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle shadow or border to the badges and keep consistent spacing from the image content.

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons sit on the images in semi-transparent dark circles. On the pizza card the button blends into the wooden background, so it is less visible than the ramen one.
issues.suggestion: Use a more opaque or contrasting background for the favorite buttons so they look the same on every image.

issues.description: The decorative circles on the green promo banner are faint, and the bottom-right circle appears to have a hard-edged corner where it is clipped. This looks slightly unpolished.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes cleanly to the banner's rounded corners or adjust their placement.
